name: claude-usage-indicator
description: Shows Claude 5-hour and weekly limit usage (%) in the status bar. Optionally appends ChatGPT limits to the tooltip.

claudeUsageIndicator.showChatGpt.description: Append ChatGPT plan limits to the status-bar tooltip. Off leaves the status bar and tooltip unchanged. The access token is read from Ungate (openai provider) or ~/.codex/auth.json and is not refreshed.

claudeUsageIndicator.codexAuthPath.description: Codex auth file for ChatGPT limits (default: ~/.codex/auth.json). Used only when showChatGpt is enabled.

claudeUsageIndicator.ungateUrl.description: Base URL of a remote Ungate (e.g. Cloudflare tunnel). If set, the extension sends a 1-token probe request and reads anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* headers. API key is stored in SecretStorage (command: Configure remote Ungate).

claudeUsageIndicator.probeModel.description: Model id for the probe request to remote Ungate (cheapest model recommended).

claudeUsageIndicator.statuslineCachePath.description: Fallback JSON written by Claude Code statusline (default: ~/.claude/usage-cache.json).
